- Ability to read and interpret blueprint, sketches and drawings

Pay rate is between $38.00/hr (casual) based on your experience for normal time hours worked. Overtime may be offered. It is desirable that you have had recent experience as a Trades Assistant / Product Assembler with the ability to use variety of handheld power tools.     Key Responsibilities :    
 
 Assemble new components and machines to a high standard, following all QC processes.
